label: Put it all on a market stall

risk.result: The stall takes off. You are, briefly, a businessperson.

label: Stand for the student council

risk.result: You lose to a boy who promised free pizza.

label: Start a pink clothes brand

risk.result: Three influencers wear it. Sales are brisk.

label: Invite them for Sunday lunch

risk.result: They critique the flat, the food and your posture.

label: Throw a dish-burning party

risk.result: The fire brigade is not impressed. Neither is the landlord.

label: Post the whole saga online

risk.result: The landlord's solicitor writes back. In capital letters.

label: Move out tonight and sue

risk.result: Lawyers cost more than mould.

label: Go and live in a van

risk.result: January in a van is not a lifestyle choice.

label: Pitch your own idea for the role

risk.result: They thank you. Nobody ever calls.

label: Start your own company instead

risk.result: It turns out invoices are a lot of work.

label: Go to their office and ask questions

risk.result: The office is a van. The van is leaving fast.

label: Haggle for the whole shop

risk.result: There is a queue. The queue has opinions.

label: Sell it to the lad behind you

risk.result: He wanted it for parts. Now you are the villain.

label: Walk home along the river

risk.result: You lost your phone. And a shoe.

death.cause: The river was colder and deeper than it looked.

label: Report them to the bouncers

risk.result: They know your face now. Every weekend.

label: Pitch the boss a four-day week

risk.result: The boss writes your name down. Not kindly.

label: Train for a triathlon

risk.result: Your knee files a complaint at mile two.

label: Apply for a restaurant kitchen job

risk.result: The chef throws a pan. At you.

label: Get it removed this afternoon

risk.result: The scar is bigger than the mole was.

death.cause: It was more than a mole, and it was found too late.

label: Book a one-way ticket and vanish

risk.result: The job you left is not waiting. Nor is the flat.

label: Move in with them all

risk.result: Nine people, one bathroom. It ends badly.

label: Go into business with them

risk.result: The business works. You bought a round.

label: Propose to your own date there

risk.result: They say no. In front of the whole room.

label: Move there and don't come back

risk.result: You are ill, broke and learning the language.

label: Start your own tattoo studio

risk.result: There is a queue out the door.

label: Quit your job for it. Full-time.

risk.result: The market was fond of you for about a month.

label: Hire an accountant and dispute it all

risk.result: The accountant bills by the minute. So does the tax office.

label: Buy a one-way ticket to anywhere

risk.result: Anywhere turns out to be quite expensive.

label: Open your own kitchen at weekends

risk.result: The food bill does not feed itself.

label: Get them a smart speaker and a tablet

risk.result: They now call you at 3am to ask what Alexa is.

label: Start a pigeon rescue

risk.result: The neighbours call it a pigeon problem.

label: Write your own name. Be your own next of kin.

risk.result: The clerk's face tells you what they think.
